tree.t: Incidental pituitary lesion on CT or MRI

c.t:
No further imaging
Correlate for
hypersecretion;
consider endocrine tests

note:
Applies to asymptomatic adults imaged for an unrelated reason. * Optic chiasm or nerve, cavernous sinus. † Manage as solid if composition cannot be determined. ‡ Consider a pseudolesion; pseudolesions need no further management.
Incidental pituitary uptake on FDG PET: use the same pathway; if composition or size cannot be assessed, obtain a pituitary MRI.
cite: Hoang JK et al. Management of Incidental Pituitary Findings on CT, MRI, and 18F-Fluorodeoxyglucose PET: A White Paper of the ACR Incidental Findings Committee. J Am Coll Radiol. 2018;15(7):966-972.
